TOPIC9.7
Defining Polar
Coordinates and
Differentiating
in Polar Form
LEARNINGOBJECTIVE
FUN-3.G
Calculate derivatives of
functions written in polar
coordinates. bc only
ESSENTIALKNOWLEDGE
FUN-3.G.1
Methods for calculating derivatives of real-
valued functions can be extended to functions
in polar coordinates. bc only
FUN-3.G.2
For a curve given by a polar equation r = f(θ),
derivatives of r, x,and ywith respect to θ, and
first and second derivatives of ywith respect to
xcan provide information about the curve.
bc only
ENDURINGUNDERSTANDING
FUN-3
Recognizing opportunities to apply derivative rules can simplify differentiation.
